snippet.title: Splatoon 3: Expansion Pass - Side Order DLC Release Date Reveal
snippet.description:
Side Order, Wave 2 of the #Splatoon3: Expansion Pass paid DLC, arrives Thursday, February 22nd.
 
The Splatoon 3: Expansion Pass is available now: https://splatoon.nintendo.com/en/expansion-pass/
